name: Helldivers 2 Galactic War
description:
Helldivers 2 Galactic War for Corsair XENEON Edge.

Turn the wide Edge display into a live Galactic War command panel built around the information that matters between missions.

Major Order: see the current order, readable briefing, segmented objective progress when it can be decoded safely, and a live expiry countdown.

Priority fronts: active campaigns are sorted with timed defenses first, then the fronts with the most meaningful progress. Each card shows planet, faction name, progress, and deployed divers.

Planet detail by touch: tap a campaign to expand factual planet status, sector, biome, region progress, hazards, and defense timing where available.

War status: active fronts, deployed divers, and a clearly labeled derived Front Progress summary keep the wider war readable at a glance.

War feed: active planet events lead the ticker, followed by real changes observed between successful API snapshots and current campaign facts.

Built for all eight XENEON slot orientations. Extra Large gets the full command board while smaller slots deliberately hide secondary detail instead of shrinking it into unreadable text.

Uses the community Helldivers 2 API with last known good caching. No game art, publisher logos, developer logos, or faction insignia are included.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for Corsair XENEON Edge.
release_notes: Initial release. Major Order briefing and objective view, live expiry countdown, priority campaign cards, defense aware and region aware progress, deployed player counts, derived Front Progress summary, touch planet detail, war feed, last known good network caching, stale and offline states, and tuned layouts for S, M, L, and XL in horizontal and vertical orientations.
